fluff.overview: The Hoverbike is a light hover support vehicle developed for the Republic of the Sphere in the late thirty-first century. Designed to provide individual soldiers with the speed and mobility of a hovertank at a fraction of the cost, the Hoverbike fills a reconnaissance and fast attack role for militia and irregular forces across the Inner Sphere.
fluff.capabilities:
Capable of reaching nearly 190 kilometers per hour, the Hoverbike offers exceptional speed for its size. Its compact hover chassis can navigate terrain inaccessible to larger vehicles, making it ideal for scouting and flanking maneuvers. The standard configuration pairs a support laser with a support machine gun, giving the rider flexibility against both soft and lightly armored targets. An advanced fire control system assists target acquisition at high speed.

Protection is modest, as the Hoverbike's light frame limits its armor coverage. While adequate against small arms fire, the vehicle is vulnerable to any dedicated anti-vehicle weapon. The Hoverbike also carries 107 kilograms of cargo, useful for extended patrols or supply runs.
fluff.deployment: The standard Hoverbike mounts a support laser and a support machine gun, offering a balanced weapons loadout for general patrol and security duties. This configuration sees the widest distribution among militia and irregular units.
fluff.history:
The Republic Armed Forces introduced the Hoverbike as part of a broader effort to equip militia and garrison units with affordable, effective equipment. Drawing on the same design philosophy as the Skimmer, the Hoverbike traded payload capacity for raw speed and a weapons fit suitable for light combat.

The design proved popular well beyond its intended audience. Irregular forces, planetary militias, and even some regular formations adopted the Hoverbike for reconnaissance and security patrols. Several Clans also incorporated the vehicle into their touman, recognizing its value as a fast, inexpensive scout platform.
